WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS month_date,
        TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM')
),
month_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        gross_revenue,
        LAG(gross_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS prev_month_revenue,
        gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS month_over_month_increase
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month AS revenue_month, month_over_month_increase
FROM month_diff
WHERE month_over_month_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_over_month_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS user_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY oi.created_at) AS order_rank,
        oi.created_at AS order_created_at
    FROM users u
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
      AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
),
FirstOrders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_created_at AS first_created_at
    FROM RankedOrders WHERE order_rank = 1
),
SecondOrders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_created_at AS second_created_at
    FROM RankedOrders WHERE order_rank = 2
),
Pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (so.second_created_at - fo.first_created_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_diff
    FROM FirstOrders fo
    JOIN SecondOrders so ON fo.user_id = so.user_id
),
OrderedPairs AS (
    SELECT *, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY days_diff) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM Pairs
)
SELECT ROUND(days_diff::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM OrderedPairs
WHERE rn = (total_count + 1) / 2

WITH user_creation AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS user_id,
        created_at,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month_start
    FROM public.users
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) < '2025-01-01'
),
user_order_with_max AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN created_at END) AS max_order_date
    FROM public.order_items
    GROUP BY user_id
),
user_has_recent_order AS (
    SELECT 
        uc.user_id,
        uc.month_start,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(uom.max_order_date, '1900-01-01') IS NOT NULL 
            AND COALESCE(uom.max_order_date, '1900-01-01') <= uc.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_order_within_30_days
    FROM user_creation uc
    LEFT JOIN user_order_with_max uom ON uc.user_id = uom.user_id
),
month_conversion AS (
    SELECT 
        month_start AS month,
        ROUND((SUM(has_order_within_30_days)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS conversion_rate
    FROM user_has_recent_order
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY 1
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    conversion_rate AS share_of_new_users_with_orders_within_30_days
FROM month_conversion
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC

        user_id,

    FROM user_order_rankings

ranked_values AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY days_between) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count,

median_calc AS (
    SELECT
